decisions: Minutes from the November 19, 2025 board meeting approved unanimously without amendments.
Approved reallocation of $200,000 from the contingency reserve to cover Q4 2025 infrastructure cost overrun; Pierre Dubois to present revised Q1 2026 operational budget by January 15, 2026.

Approved pursuit of expanded Acme Corp contract targeting $1.8 million annual value; Aiyana Park to assemble dedicated account team by January 10, 2026; Pierre Dubois to submit revised commercial proposal to Acme Corp by January 20, 2026.

Approved 2026 Strategic Growth Plan with phased geographic expansion: Pacific Northwest launch in Q2 2026, Quebec market launch in Q3 2026; Aiyana Park to deliver operational rollout plan by February 28, 2026.

Approved updated employee compensation and retention policy effective January 1, 2026, including 5% salary adjustment, 8% net profit performance bonus pool, and $3,000 annual professional development stipend per employee; Pierre Dubois to communicate terms to staff by December 31, 2025.

Aiyana Park authorized to initiate CRM contract renewal negotiations with DataStream Solutions, targeting completion by January 25, 2026; all board members to confirm attendance at January 16, 2026 client event by January 5, 2026.
